onetSkills.note: Real O*NET flag rows (Lightcast via O*NET, US job ads) for one job, 15-1252.00 Software Developers, plus a few Hot Technologies rows from other jobs. Taken from the bundled onet-skills snapshot; only Scenario C adds a fictional change.
